name: dither-shader
title: Dither Shader
blurb: Canvas-rendered images with dithering patterns and color quantization.
description: Applies ordered dithering (bayer, halftone, noise, crosshatch) and color reduction to images on canvas. Supports brightness, contrast, palette modes, and optional frame animation.
use_when: Artistic image effects for portfolio galleries, retro aesthetic, or stylized presentations.
avoid_when: Real-time video or high-volume image galleries — canvas processing has per-frame CPU cost.
a11y: Canvas-rendered with aria-label and role=img. Image source is loaded and processed but not directly exposed to screen readers.
